title: Trastuzumab and Pertuzumab for HER2-Positive Metastatic Colorectal Cancer
brief_summary: Clinical trial 20 for Metastatic Colorectal Adenocarcinoma. This is a Phase 2 study.
detailed_description: This clinical trial evaluates the efficacy and safety of investigational therapy for Metastatic Colorectal Adenocarcinoma. Participants will be assessed for response, progression-free survival, and overall survival.
inclusion_criteria: Histologically confirmed mCRC with HER2 overexpression (IHC 3+ or IHC 2+ with FISH+); At least one prior line of therapy; ECOG PS 0-1; Measurable disease
exclusion_criteria: Prior HER2-targeted therapy; Symptomatic brain metastases; Severe cardiac dysfunction
eligibility_criteria: Histologically confirmed mCRC with HER2 overexpression (IHC 3+ or IHC 2+ with FISH+); At least one prior line of therapy; ECOG PS 0-1; Measurable disease. Exclusion: Prior HER2-targeted therapy; Symptomatic brain metastases; Severe cardiac dysfunction
